label: github: switch to jrussbunnell (personal)
command: (gh auth switch --hostname github.com --user jrussbunnell || gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web) && git config --local --replace-all credential.https://github.com.helper '' && git config --local --add credential.https://github.com.helper '!gh auth git-credential' && git config --local user.name jrussbunnell && git config --local user.email joshua.r.bunnell@gmail.com && gh auth status --active && git config --local user.email

label: github: switch to joshuaatryse (work)
command: (gh auth switch --hostname github.com --user joshuaatryse || gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web) && git config --local --replace-all credential.https://github.com.helper '' && git config --local --add credential.https://github.com.helper '!gh auth git-credential' && git config --local user.name joshuaatryse && git config --local user.email joshua@rysemarket.com && gh auth status --active && git config --local user.email

label: github: show active account
command: gh auth status --active; echo; echo "git user: $(git config user.name) <$(git config user.email)>"
